# ViewsMax

> ViewsMax is a social posting + link tracking/analytics SaaS for creators and
> marketers. Compose and schedule posts to YouTube, TikTok, X, LinkedIn,
> Threads, Instagram, and Bluesky; create offers and tracked links; see which
> posts and platforms drive clicks, conversions, and revenue; research outlier
> videos (content that massively over-performed its channel) with AI breakdowns
> of why they worked. User data is private — AI agents act on a user's behalf
> via an authenticated MCP server (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, or a per-user API key) or
> the REST API.

## AI & Agent Access

- [ViewsMax MCP server](https://viewsmax.com/mcp.md): what the MCP exposes (26 tools, grouped by job), auth modes, rate limits, and setup per client
- [Connect your AI](https://viewsmax.com/ai.md): copy-paste setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and raw REST
- [Capability discovery (JSON)](https://api.viewsmax.com/api/ai): MCP endpoint, auth modes, full tool list, rate limits
- MCP endpoint: https://api.viewsmax.com/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP; Bearer auth — OAuth 2.1 + PKCE with dynamic client registration, or a `vmx_` API key from Settings → AI Assistant Access)
- [OpenAPI spec](https://api.viewsmax.com/docs.openapi) · [REST API reference](https://api.viewsmax.com/docs)
- OAuth discovery: https://api.viewsmax.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
- [OpenClaw skill](https://viewsmax.com/skills/viewsmax/SKILL.md)

## Agent Setup Guides

- [Claude](https://viewsmax.com/claude.md): custom connector, OAuth
- [Claude Code](https://viewsmax.com/claude-code.md): `claude mcp add --transport http`, OAuth or API key
- [Claude Cowork](https://viewsmax.com/claude-cowork.md): shares the claude.ai connector
- [ChatGPT](https://viewsmax.com/chatgpt.md): Developer mode custom connector, OAuth
- [Codex](https://viewsmax.com/codex.md): `codex mcp add`, OAuth or API key
- [Cursor](https://viewsmax.com/cursor.md): `~/.cursor/mcp.json`, API key
- [OpenClaw](https://viewsmax.com/openclaw.md): ViewsMax skill over the REST API, API key
- [Hermes Agent](https://viewsmax.com/hermes.md): `~/.hermes/config.yaml`, OAuth or API key
